subject: Bootstrapping in moderated mediation with nested models

messages.author: b7ec992998544970
messages.subject: Bootstrapping in moderated mediation with nested models
parts:
Hi all, 

I was running a moderated mediation model with the nested design. I used lavaan.survey to designate nests. However, with the nested design, how should I run bootstrapping? The current code did not return me a bootstrapping result. How should I justify if the moderation should be retained or not?

Thanks!


## moderated mediation model, with 'stage' being the nominal moderator. The moderator has four levels

m2 ='
csd ~ c(c1,c2,c3,c4)*sd + c(b1,b2,b3,b4)*lsm
lsm ~ c(a1,a2,a3,a4)*sd

ind1 := a1*b1
tot1 := a1*b1+c1
ind2 := a2*b2
tot2 := a2*b2+c2
ind3 := a3*b3
tot3 := a3*b3+c3
ind4 := a4*b4
tot4 := a4*b4+c4

'
fit2=sem(m2, data=dm, fixed.x = FALSE,group='stage', test='bootstrap')


##assgin 'poster' and 'commenter' as the nests

library(lavaan.survey)
design <- svydesign(ids=~poster+commenter, nest=TRUE, data=dm)


## fit the nested model

fit.total2 <- lavaan.survey(lavaan.fit=fit2, survey.design=design)  
summary(fit.total2, fit.measures = TRUE, standard = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)

messages.author: b8fd92e5e3662745
messages.subject: Re: Bootstrapping in moderated mediation with nested models
parts:
survey::as.svrepdesign()... although I don't really know how it is
going to handle what you called a nested design. (Nested models in
your subject line are two models that differ only in that the
parameters in the richer model are restricted to specific values in
the nested model. In survey statistics, there is no "nested" designs,
there are multistage samples -- as well as two-phase sampling designs.
I am not sure either of these applies here.)

How the svrepdesign() is going to interact with lavaan is beyond me,
Dan would definitely know -- my expectation is that it won't have any
problems.
